title: Homo naledi
summary: Homo naledi is a small-bodied hominin known from the Rising Star Cave system in South Africa, with over 1,550 specimens from at least 15 individuals in the Dinaledi Chamber. It combines Australopithecus-like and Homo-like traits. Dating places it about 236,000 to 335,000 years ago, overlapping early Homo sapiens.

uncertainty.note: Converted with year = 1950 minus years ago. Range is the depositional age 236-335 ka of Dirks et al. (2017); the sediment unit alone is 236-414 ka.

as_recorded.value: Depositional age 236 ka to 335 ka (sediments 236-414 ka)
When Lived: 335,000 - 236,000 years ago; dated in 2017

where.historical_name: Dolomite cave system in southern Africa, no polity

importance.justification: A late-surviving, small-brained Homo species that shows hominin diversity in Africa alongside early Homo sapiens.
